description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring Boot REST controller for managing reading goals in a book tracking application. It includes endpoints for creating, deleting, and retrieving reading goals, with some validation and error handling.

classes.name: ReadingGoalController
classes.description: A REST controller for handling reading goal related HTTP requests, such as creating, deleting, and retrieving reading goals.

methods.name: deleteReadingGoal
methods.description: Deletes all reading goals by invoking the service layer.

methods.name: addBookReadingGoal
methods.description: Creates a new reading goal based on the number of books target, with validation.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal
methods.description: Creates a new reading goal based on the number of pages target, with validation.

methods.name: getExistingReadingGoal
methods.description: Retrieves the current reading goal or throws an exception if none exists.
